sentences.text: Prosecution case, in short, is that on 03.07.2010 complainant Anil Kumar Katare lodged an FIR at police station Vijaypur, District Guna alleging that his land which is situated at Kolua Maidani bearing survey No. 100/3/2 area 0.314 hectare was sold by unauthorized person illegally.
On his report, Crime No.60/2010 for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B of IPC was registered.
After purchasing the said land, Anil Kumar Katare's name was mutated in revenue record, since he is unable to look after the land.

Thereafter, the affidavit was submitted before the Tehsildar and said affidavit has been signed by Rajendra Kumar Gupta on behalf of Anil Kumar and affidavit was attested by Jugal Kishor.
Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and after perusing of the records, this court is of the considered opinion that no ground is made out to quash the FIR and other consequential proceedings related thereto, therefore, the present petition filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is hereby dismissed.
